snippet.title: Invokyr - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Invokyr will be available on Steam on October 8th, in Early Access.

Invokyr is a co-op horror adventure where up to 4 players are trapped inside a cursed board game. Roll the dice, survive the board’s supernatural events, and work together to escape before the Game Master makes you part of the game forever.

Play the demo and wishlist Invokyr now on Steam.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/38...

Join the Ludogram discord to get access to private playtests & discussions
Discord: https://discord.gg/qeAb8EBbZy
